# Security reports

Use **Report a vulnerability** under this repository's Security tab when available.
If private reporting is unavailable, open an issue asking for a private contact
without including exploit details. Do not post player saves, encryption keys or
personal paths. Include the affected version and a synthetic reproducer if possible.

Fixes target the latest release. Checksums verify save structure; they do not
prove that an edit is safe to load in-game. Keep independent backups.
